source_locator.section: The Influence of the Four Angles
source_locator.short_quote: The western point, or occidental angle, is moist

normalized_rule: Classify the Descendant, the western or occidental angle, as moist in Ptolemy's angular scheme.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific angular classification, not a later house-rulership or scientific geography claim.
review_notes: Keep the four angle-quality rules separate from sign qualities and later house interpretations.
transmission_notes: The angular quality is stated in the Ashmand/Proclus main text; it is not mapped to later house-rulership doctrine.
